title: Let hope outrank the world's reach
summary: Hope in the Lord outranks the reach of the world. Let the Guru-revealed Lord outrank the world's reach.
takeaway: Let the Guru-revealed Lord outrank the world's reach.
lifeApplication: When pressure swells, remember what the world cannot show you and place hope where the Guru reveals the Perfect One.

source.shortMeaning: Hope in the Lord outranks the reach of the world.
source.lifeApplication: When pressure swells, remember what the world can reach and what it cannot.
